structuredData.name: Soul Bowlz
structuredData.description: Soul Bowlz Is A Healthy, Nutrient Packed Bowl Of Wholesome Goodness. We Mix Fresh, Frozen, And Exotic Super Fruits With No Ice, No Dairy And No Processed Sugars To Create And Delicious Treat.

meta.og:title: Soul Bowlz - Frozen acai bowls and smoothies.
meta.og:description: Soul Bowlz offers  nutrient-packed bowls of wholesome goodness with blend choices of acai, pitaya, graviola and acerola. Enjoy a delicious frozen acai berry bowl or smoothie at one of our 3 locations in Gulf Shores, AL, Fairhope, AL, or Mobile, AL.
